scripts.test:beta-costs: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-poplur-beta-costs --config ../firebase.beta-local.json --only firestore,auth "node scripts/testBetaCostControls.js"
scripts.test:claim-radius-rules: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "node scripts/testClaimRadiusRules.mjs"
scripts.test:claim-radius-aggregate: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "node scripts/testEngagementAggregate.mjs && node scripts/testBackfillAccountClaimRadius.mjs"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,functions,firestore
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions,firestore:rules
